# Beyond Senior Living

> Assisted living home at {{street}}, {{city}}, Minnesota {{zip}}, serving families across the Twin Cities. Awake staff on site 24/7, a registered nurse who makes site visits and is on call 24/7, and on-site physician and nurse practitioner services from the Bluestone team.

- Phone: {{phone}}
- Fax: {{fax}}
- Email: {{email}}
- Payment accepted: private pay, long-term care insurance, Minnesota Medicaid waivers (Brain Injury (BI), CADI, Elderly Waiver (EW))
- Areas served: Woodbury, Saint Paul, Minneapolis, Cottage Grove, Oakdale, Maplewood, Lake Elmo, Afton, Newport, Stillwater

## Services

- [All assisted living services](https://beyondseniorlivingmn.com/services/): overview of care included for every resident
- [Person-centered care](https://beyondseniorlivingmn.com/services/person-centered-care/): individualized care plans, help with ADLs and IADLs, medication management, respite care; residents living with Parkinson's, COPD, CHF, stroke, diabetes, mental illness, hospice or palliative care
- [Health care](https://beyondseniorlivingmn.com/services/health-care/): trained, background-checked staff, monitored security and fire systems, everyday wellness support
- [Medical services](https://beyondseniorlivingmn.com/services/medical-services/): RN and specialized care (wound care, insulin, catheter, oxygen, CPAP, INR, ostomy, hospice coordination) and on-site physician and nurse practitioner visits
